title: Fake Research Participant Pay
scenario: A study offers high pay for sharing ID and bank details before consent forms.

answers.A: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.B: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.C: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.
answers.D: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.

explanation: Fake Research Participant Pay: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Legitimate studies have ethics information and official contacts.
